title: The vet
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: The county vet guesses a year. Wood guesses a name for the breed. Neither is right.

panels.composition: A county veterinary clinic. BARNABY on the steel table, unimpressed. A VET with a stethoscope. WOOD holding the sock.

balloons.text: About a year. Terrier and something. Hound, maybe. Beagle.

image.prompt: a small veterinary clinic, a scruffy terrier-hound on a steel table, a vet listening with a stethoscope, a young man holding a sock

panels.composition: The breed poster. Wood's finger on it, on nothing in particular.

image.prompt: close-up of a young man's finger on a dog-breed poster pointing at nothing in particular
a vet writing on a clipboard chart while a young man answers, a dog on the table
image.notes: Owner: Finch. The world's paperwork uses the real name; the strip lets it through as it did the yearbook.

panels.composition: Outside. Barnaby on a real leash now, bought at the counter. Wood, the receipt in his teeth, tying his shoe. The dog waiting like he's done it forever.

characters.pose: tying his shoe, receipt in teeth

image.prompt: outside a vet clinic in the rain, a scruffy dog on a new leash waiting patiently while a young man ties his shoe with a receipt in his teeth, black and white, no words
